image_description: A dark wood, antique-style bookcase (hutch style) featuring an upper section with glass-paned doors and open shelving, and a lower section with solid cabinet doors and open cubbies. The unit is filled with books and decorative objects like vases and plates. It stands against a wood-paneled wall on a wooden floor.

artifact_observations.location: Book spines on middle-right shelf and lower-left cubby
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the book spines is illegible and appears as blurred, nonsensical patterns rather than distinct characters, a common AI artifact in rendering small text.
The geometry of the lower-left cabinet door and its handle appears slightly warped and indistinct compared to the crisp lines of the rest of the furniture, suggesting minor structural ambiguity.
The pattern on the blue vase lacks clear definition and seems to blend into the background slightly, lacking the sharp edge definition expected of a ceramic object.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of book spines (text artifacts)
Geometric integrity of glass door frames and mullions
Consistency of wood grain and reflections across different planes
Structural plausibility of lower cabinet handles and joints
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines; AI often fails to render coherent text at this resolution. Check if the glass reflections match the implied light source. Verify that the perspective lines of the shelves converge correctly towards a vanishing point.
